lines.en: Zara, the report is late again. Why didn’t you tell anyone that you were struggling?
lines.pt: Zara, o relatório está atrasado de novo. Por que você não contou a ninguém que estava com dificuldade?

lines.en: I didn’t want to bother people. I thought everyone was busy with their own deadlines.
lines.pt: Eu não queria incomodar as pessoas. Achei que todos estavam ocupados com os próprios prazos.

lines.en: Our manager would have helped if you had asked her. She finished her project last week.
lines.pt: Nossa gerente teria ajudado se você tivesse pedido a ela. Ela terminou o projeto dela semana passada.

lines.en: Really? If I had known she had free time, I would have asked for her advice.
lines.pt: Sério? Se eu soubesse que ela tinha tempo livre, teria pedido o conselho dela.

lines.en: She would have rearranged her schedule, too. She did exactly the same for me last spring.
lines.pt: Ela teria reorganizado a agenda também. Ela fez exatamente isso por mim na primavera passada.

lines.en: I should have asked sooner. If I had said something on Monday, we would have avoided this mess.
lines.pt: Eu devia ter pedido antes. Se eu tivesse dito algo na segunda, teríamos evitado essa bagunça.

lines.en: Do not be too hard on yourself. I would have offered my help if I had noticed you were stressed.
lines.pt: Não seja tão dura consigo mesma. Eu teria oferecido ajuda se tivesse notado que você estava estressada.

lines.en: Thank you. If you had offered, I would have accepted immediately. I just hated feeling helpless.
lines.pt: Obrigada. Se você tivesse oferecido, eu teria aceitado na hora. Só odiei me sentir impotente.

lines.en: Everyone needs help sometimes. The team would have understood if you had explained the situation.
lines.pt: Todo mundo precisa de ajuda às vezes. A equipe teria entendido se você tivesse explicado a situação.

lines.en: Next time, I will ask for support early. Could you read my draft before I send it?
lines.pt: Da próxima vez, vou pedir apoio cedo. Você poderia ler meu rascunho antes de eu enviar?

lines.en: Of course. Send it over, and we will fix the figures in chapter three together.
lines.pt: Claro. Mande para mim e vamos corrigir os números do capítulo três juntos.

facts.big: She would have helped if you had asked
facts.label: 3º condicional: ajuda
facts.sub: Would have + particípio, if + had + particípio: She would have helped if you had asked. A ordem das partes pode mudar.

facts.label: teria ajudado
facts.sub: Use would have + particípio para dizer o que alguém teria feito: She would have helped. I would have offered my help. Fala de algo que não aconteceu.

facts.label: se você tivesse pedido
facts.sub: A condição usa if + had + particípio: if you had asked, if I had noticed. A ação não aconteceu, por isso o resultado também não aconteceu.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: She would have helped if you had asked means you did not ask.
We say “She would have helped if you would have asked.”
items.why: We say if you had asked.

items.s: The if-part can come at the end of the sentence.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She would have helped if you had asked means you did not ask. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She would have helped if you would have asked.” → Falso (We say if you had asked.)
The if-part can come at the end of the sentence. → Verdadeiro (Yes, without a comma.)

pages.title: A late report in Atlanta · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet Friday afternoon in an Atlanta office. Most of the team has already gone home. Zara sits alone in front of two screens. Cody walks past her desk with his jacket on. He sees her tired eyes and stops. He pulls up a chair and sits beside her.

“Zara, the report is late again. Why didn’t you tell anyone that you were struggling?” says Cody. “I didn’t want to bother people. I thought everyone was busy with their own deadlines.” says Zara. “Our manager would have helped if you had asked her. She finished her project last week.” says Cody.
